content: {"phoneNote":"The framed hero card eats the whole first screen so the photos only peek in below it, and the arch picture is sliced off at the right edge, which reads as misaligned rather than composed.","desktopNote":"The hero is strong, but the about section falls apart: the heading „Cvetje, vezano z roko” floats alone at the far right while the eyebrow and giant 2010 sit left, leaving a dead band beneath.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Shorten the phone hero card so the arch photo and bouquet circle show in the first screen, and keep the arch fully inside the viewport instead of cropping it at the right edge.","Rebuild the desktop about section: place the heading above the 2010/text columns, shrink the 2010 figure and remove the empty band beneath it.","Use a different photo for the Lončnice oval so the bouquet is not shown twice, and give the desktop „Darilne košarice” button real padding so the label stops touching its edges."],"blockers":["The same bouquet photo appears twice: in the hero circle and again in the Lončnice oval, on both phone and desktop."]}
